description: Compute the exact total for a visit: each dog's wash or full groom by size + chosen extras, minus the first-visit discount, plus the extended-area travel fee when it applies. Use this to state a confident, exact price instead of doing the math yourself.

addons.description: Add-ons the customer wants, if any.

address_or_city.description: Where the van comes, so the extended-area travel fee is included when it applies.

dog_size.description: Single dog WASH: size tier (Small <20 lbs, Medium 20–60, Large 60–100, XL/Giant 100+). Omit when using dogs.

dogs.description: One entry per dog (up to 4 per visit). Use this for more than one dog or for a full groom; each dog gets its own service and extras.

addons.description: Paid extras for this dog, if wanted.

service.description: wash = full bath, blow-dry, nails, ears, brush-out. groom = everything in the wash PLUS full haircut, face/feet/sanitary trim, paw pads.

size.description: Size tier (Small <20 lbs, Medium 20–60, Large 60–100, XL/Giant 100+).

first_wash.description: true if this is a first-time customer — applies the WASH10 ($10 off) discount.

title: Get a price quote
